name: benchmark_math
description: benchmark_math is a collection of math problems designed to evaluate models' mathematical reasoning and problem-solving ability across elementary to advanced topics. Problems typically require symbolic manipulation, multi-step reasoning, and numeric answers, and can be used to assess both closed-form and free-response performance.
evaluation_method: accuracy / exact_match (correct numeric or symbolic answer)
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face used for testing math reasoning capabilities but with limited broad adoption or benchmarking history.
